_readme: 可复用术语表模板（示例条目，按学科替换）。每个条目: preferred=锁定译法, variants=违规变体, source_form=锁定绑定的原文词(缺省用 concept key), abbreviation=目标语可用的缩写, basis=译法依据(标准/教科书/领域惯例), 供 xlate.term_variant / xlate.term_missing / xlate.term_entry_no_basis / xlate.glossary_conflict 四条规则使用。

吸附.basis: IUPAC Compendium of Chemical Terminology, sorption covers both adsorption and absorption

机器学习.basis: textbook convention; ML allowed after first mention

吸收率.basis: field convention in coating/permeation studies; distinct from 吸附 above
